description: This PHP source file defines a class 'OA_DB_DataObject_Generator' that extends the PEAR 'DB_DataObject_Generator' to generate database data object classes and configuration files based on database schema definitions, with custom logic for data types and class generation.

classes.name: OA_DB_DataObject_Generator
classes.description: A class extending PEAR's DB_DataObject_Generator to generate data object classes and schema configuration files with custom data type mapping and class generation logic.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the generation process, creates table list, generates schema definitions, writes schema ini, and generates class files.

methods.name: _createTableList
methods.description: Builds the list of database tables and their definitions, applying exclusion regex and mapping data types.

methods.name: _writeSchemaIni
methods.description: Writes the generated schema configuration to a 'db_schema.ini' file.

methods.name: deriveDataType
methods.description: Determines the PEAR DB_DataObject data type constant based on schema field type and database type.

methods.name: generateForeignKeys
methods.description: Placeholder for generating foreign key links; managed manually.

methods.name: generateClasses
methods.description: Generates PHP class files for each database table, including class headers, fields, and getter/setter methods.

methods.name: _generateClassTable
methods.description: Creates the PHP class code for a specific table, including class definition, fields, and auto-generated methods.

methods.name: _generateDefinitionsTable
methods.description: Generates schema definitions for a table to be written into 'db_schema.ini'.

methods.name: _generateDefaultsArray
methods.description: Creates default values array for table fields based on schema and predefined nulls.

search-terms: generate class files for database tables
